units.source_text: 头中将说：“以后我常常这样地跟着你走，怎么样？”

en.t: To no Chujo said, "From now on, how would it be if I often followed along with you like this?"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“老实对你说：做这种事，全靠随身者能干，才得成功。

en.t: Then he added, "To tell you honestly, in affairs like this, success depends entirely on having capable attendants with you.

units.source_text: 以后我经常跟着你走吧。

en.t: From now on, I had better go with you regularly.

units.source_text: 你一人改了装偷偷地出门，难免发生意外之事呢。”

en.t: If you go out secretly by yourself in disguise, something unexpected is bound to happen sooner or later."
He admonished him again and again.

units.source_text: 源氏公子这种勾当，过去常常被头中将看破，心中很懊恼。

en.t: Prince Genji had often had schemes of this kind seen through by To no Chujo in the past, and inwardly he was deeply vexed by it.

units.source_text: 但想起夕颜所生的那个抚子，头中将却找不到，便居功自傲，引以为快。

en.t: But when he thought of the little Nadeshiko born to Yugao, whom To no Chujo had been unable to find, he took pride in that achievement and found satisfaction in it.
